capabilities: Capture messages from Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, email, SMS or Raycast
Save captures directly to Obsidian notes using a configured template
Route captures through a Hints bot and the Hints web app
Select captures with a tag (default #obsidian) configured in a Hints flow
disambiguation: Not a standalone AI assistant; it depends on the external Hints web app and bot to route captures into the vault.
extras: Requires setup outside Obsidian: a free Hints account, creating a flow in the Hints web app, and publishing it before use; advanced use cases are documented on the author's website, not in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to remotely capture content from messaging apps and other external services into vault notes.

relations.evidence: Forward or send any message to Hints bot via Telegram, WhatsApp or Slack
Send via Email, SMS or capture with RayCast

requires.name: Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, Email, SMS or Raycast

summary: Quick-capture plugin that saves messages sent through Hints AI from Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, email, SMS or Raycast into notes using a template.
